$description: Theme A · c1xxstudio.com. Fills the foundations' contracts: font families, the accent set, shadow hue, and one canvas override. Everything else is inherited.

display.$description: Light italic only, for an intentional phrase — never a full paragraph.

accent.$description: The site's primary action is Ink, not a hue: dark pill buttons on paper (inverted in dark mode). Hue is reserved for signal and per-project scenes. Mode-aware because the ink/paper pair flips.

signal.$description: Active navigation, scroll progress. 3.19:1 on canvas — passes non-text and large-text AA only; never body copy.

ring.$description: Overrides semantic.focus.ring. DESIGN.md's #ff633c measures 2.9:1 on Paper and fails the 3:1 non-text minimum, so focus uses Ink (16.5:1); the orange stays as scene.highlight.orange. Dark mode: the semantic dark value (signal, 5.2:1) applies.

scene.$description: Per-project accents. Theme-level, not foundations: used for arrows, small type, pointer light, the next-project field. One accent per scene, low coverage.

highlight.$description: Editorial highlights used on single phrases.

aurora.$description: Ambient field over bg.canvas. Atmospheric only; must never reduce text contrast. Stays in the theme, outside the token contract.
